description: Defines data structures, enums, and API functions for managing data model transactions, including starting, adding operations, committing, aborting, and querying transaction state.

methods.name: DM_TRANS_Start
methods.description: Initializes a new data model transaction.

methods.name: DM_TRANS_Add
methods.description: Adds an operation (set, add, delete) to the current transaction.

methods.name: DM_TRANS_Commit
methods.description: Commits all operations in the current transaction.

methods.name: DM_TRANS_Abort
methods.description: Aborts the current transaction, discarding all operations.

methods.name: DM_TRANS_IsWithinTransaction
methods.description: Checks if a transaction is currently active.

methods.name: DM_TRANS_GetParamWritesByPathSpec
methods.description: Retrieves parameter write operations matching a path specification.
